scope: Existing uniswap-v3 (4), uniswap-v3-router02 (7), pancakeswap-v3 (1) deployments only. Ordinary V3 swaps plus fixed nonzero-factory Router02 V2 swaps; existing IDs and labels preserved. additions.label: uniswap-v3 exactInput
warnings: Static exact-chain/address ABI and source inventory only; no grant, fresh runtime identity, persistent implementation, liquidity, funding, financial-safety or execution guarantee. Canonical calldata/value checks, exact grants, pauses and independent policies remain mandatory.

Caller selects assets, amounts, route, fee tiers, price limits and recipient. Existing token allowance/balance and pool liquidity are required; no permit, approval, role, callback entrypoint, multicall, position-manager or settlement-helper capability is added.

All selected swaps are payable. pay wraps the constructor-bound WETH9/native wrapper only when the input token equals that wrapper and the router has enough native balance, otherwise it pulls approved caller ERC20 or uses router-held intermediate tokens. Native asset is chain-specific, not necessarily ETH; wrapped-native output remains ERC20 and is not automatically unwrapped.

Prefer approved ERC20 input with zero native value. Overpayment and partial fills can leave native or token dust in the router; swaps do not automatically refund it, public refund/sweep/unwrap helpers are excluded, and publicly callable contract helpers make router-custodied balances unsafe. Do not assume dust is reserved for this caller.
Original/Pancake tuples retain deadline and check block.timestamp against it. A zero recipient redirects output into router custody, not to the caller; use the intended nonzero token recipient.

Uniswap V3 pools are deterministically derived from immutable factory plus token pair, fee and source-fixed pool init-code hash, not a caller target. uniswapV3SwapCallback authenticates msg.sender against that derived pool before payment.

Packed path bytes encode token addresses and uint24 fee tiers only, not arbitrary calldata. exactInput follows forward token order; exactOutput requires reversed token/fee order and recurses only through authenticated pool callbacks. Malformed paths, unsupported fees or absent pools revert.
Exact-input multihop checks final amountOutMinimum; intermediate outputs are held and paid by the router. Rounding, liquidity gaps, token behavior and price movement can affect execution.

This inventory does not establish pair existence or live liquidity on every route.

Exact-output V2 computes required input from reserves, checks amountInMax, pays that input and runs the same swap loop. Fee-on-transfer or nonstandard tokens can invalidate exact-output expectations; no final recipient-balance minimum enforces net taxed receipt.
